title: Parsley Health pill button
description: A full-pill button with a medium geometric label: forest fill, a softer sage fill, a 2px forest outline, or an ochre fill, in four heights. An optional small arrow nudges 4px right on hover; fills deepen over 150ms.
notes: inside a .dark scope (nav bar, footer) primary turns bone with forest text
pass block="phone" for the original's full-width phone buttons
